scope: Fresh native/WASM qualification of the same six small QKV learning cases under an explicitly versioned graph and paired-query contract; not an overwrite of projective-v1.
previous_result: Original native/browser 4/6 qualification and raw receipts remain unchanged.

changes_from_v1.residual: Torch reference evaluates x+(attention@W+bias), matching the existing Rust module boundary; no production arithmetic change.
changes_from_v1.router_coordinate_vjp: Compare (Full-StopCoordinates) from one GPU runtime with (Full-StopCoordinates) from one CPU reference; do not mix GPU Full with CPU Stop in the qualification contrast. Retain mixed-runtime formula as diagnostic only.
changes_from_v1.stopped_parameter_vjps: Independently compare every stopped parameter VJP to CPU; preserve unchanged routes, repeated Full, forward and parameter immutability checks.

required_checks: Version/schema mismatch rejects before executing the model; legacy default fixture regeneration remains byte-identical.
Initial logits, every parameter VJP, external bias VJPs, embedding gradient, all geometry relative checks, and active Topos gradient.
Every loss, every parameter tensor, every geometry VJP, and every mixture snapshot across all 16 updates; preserve and report finite failures.
Causality, tapes, geometry-off/detach controls, exact checkpoint continuation, projective boundary and atomic query guard.
Both contextual cases: active shared-forward contrast, paired coordinate pullback, active router updates, frozen-update and zero/sign-reversed pullback rejection, independent stopped VJPs.
boundaries: Any failed required check prevents full v2 qualification; do not tune seeds, steps, scales or thresholds after observing it.
All six conditions and both runtimes must be recorded, not a selected passing subset.
Only source, scalar results, hashes and reproducibility instructions are public. Raw model vectors, checkpoints and binaries remain local.
No language-quality, throughput, large-combination, CUDA, release, PR, CI or merge claim.
